description.value: You use magical shorthand to store your favorite spells in a repository called a spell cache. The spells in your cache are determined by your programming language. At 1st level, you add the 1st-rank spell indicated by your programming language to your spell cache. As soon as you gain the ability to cast technomancer spells of a new rank, add the spells of that rank from your programming language to your spell cache. Spells in your spell cache are considered to be in your spell database and can be prepared normally. You can also use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Download Spell] action to replace a prepared spell with a spell from your spell cache.
